# Resume point of 2026-11-25 (owner moves the writing to the cloud)

The owner stopped every Claude-based job on the workstation on 2026-11-21 to save the usage allowance, and on
2026-11-25 asked the lead to push everything and record a resume point for a cloud session. This file is that point.
Read it first, then `AGENTS.md`, `BUILD-STATUS.md` (sections 4 and 6), `ops/remaining-tasks.json` and
`git log origin/build/v1 -20`.

## 1. Where the build stands

- Integration branch `build/v1` (bootstrap mode, ADR-0028). Never push to `main`.
- Plan progress, counted from every plan file on `build/v1` against the `Plan-Task:` lines of merged pull requests:
  **306 of 360 plan tasks merged, 54 left** (B-601 will add five more when it merges). Remaining by plan:
  0015 task log 0/20, 0013 column workflow 8/17, 0010 footing 10/15, 0009 providers 7/11, 0007 edit cycle 23/27,
  0011 Revit 12/15, 0006 CLI 29/31, 0014 IDEA 7/9, and one each in eng-contract 0001, harness 0002, 0004, 0008 and
  structural-codes 0003. `ops/remaining-tasks.json` is a registry of work items, not a count of all plan tasks.
- Definition of done: GitHub Actions CI on the pull request head (D-42, D-44). Merge only when every check is green on
  the current head (squash, subject `<prTitle> (#N)`, body `Assisted-by: anthropic/claude`). A cancelled duplicate
  run beside a green run on the same head counts as green (case #518).
- Owner decisions of 2026-11-20: `docs/build/owner-answers-2026-11-20.md` (OQ-Q93 to OQ-Q104, all answered) and D-46 in
  `BUILD-STATUS.md` (the mutation scope follows the specs).

## 4. Resume prompt for the cloud session

> You are the lead engineer resuming the v1 build of the Eng-Agent platform (repository AbdulkareemSasah/Eng-Agent,
> branch `build/v1`). Talk to the owner in Arabic; write code, commits and documents in English. Read
> `docs/build/resume/PAUSE-2026-11-25.md` first, then AGENTS.md, BUILD-STATUS.md sections 4 and 6,
> ops/remaining-tasks.json and `git log origin/build/v1 -20`. Work the table of section 2 top to bottom: finish each
> item on its branch (new commits only, never force-push), have it reviewed by an agent that did not write it (for
> engineering calcs: every value cited, every golden value recomputed by hand), open the pull request with Work-Item,
> Plan-Task and the plan's full Risk line, and merge only on green GitHub Actions checks on the current head. Never
> invent an engineering number; ask the owner only for AGENTS.md section 7 items. At each pause update this file and
> BUILD-STATUS.md as docs(build), push, and give the owner the plan-task count (merged of total).
